final_message:
The change will likely fail independent hidden-box API tests because filtering happens after pagination:

```java
getContentBoxes(..., page, count)
    .filter(box -> box.isVisible())
```

Hidden boxes still consume page slots, so a storefront page may contain fewer items—or no visible items—even when visible boxes exist later. Pagination totals may also remain incorrect. Filtering must occur in the service/repository query before pagination.

The single-box endpoint appears correctly protected and should return 404 for hidden content, while private management access is preserved.

VERDICT: FAIL
CONFIDENCE: 90
